scientific_integrity: No assertion that the source algorithm fails; its same-batch design is preserved as the comparison. Exact distribution-free algebra and an explicit iid strong-law counterexample; no independent external scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Two-stage undamped SRKCD variant, unit outer step, independent stage curvatures in (0,8), scalar quadratic losses and exact arithmetic; almost-sure asymptotics asserted for one explicit two-point distribution only. Independent stage resampling is not the published same-minibatch algorithm.
title: Sharp mean-square frontier for stage-resampled two-stage Chebyshev descent
